method: Full unresolved-site sweep using current compiled sources. Each accepted reference has a unique contiguous instruction context and an independent established identity anchor; registers, operand widths, constants, signed reference addends and injective local-byte mapping are checked, as are internal branch targets and outgoing directions. Each owner has no overlapping source claims and its complete typed payload agrees with retail. For char-pointer tables every emitted relocation and complete pointed-to string is checked separately. No whole-body equivalence is implied.
